name: Ulalek, Fused Atrocity
oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Whenever you cast an Eldrazi spell, you may pay {C}{C}. If you do, copy all spells you control, then copy all other activated and triggered abilities you control. You may choose new targets for the copies. (Mana abilities can't be copied.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast an Eldrazi spell, you may pay {C}{C}. If you do, copy all spells you control, then copy all other activated and triggered abilities you control. You may choose new targets for the copies

needs.what: a mass-copy over the stack: copy every spell you control on the stack (new_targets per copy), then copy every activated and triggered ability you control on the stack except the resolving ability itself (new_targets per copy), mana abilities excluded
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_spell names exactly one spell (its `sid` value, a `target`, or the triggering spell) and copy_ability copies only the stack items chosen as its `target`; there is no stack-zone selector or for_each over stack items that binds each sid, so 'all spells you control' and 'all other activated and triggered abilities you control' cannot be enumerated, and targeting a fixed number of them would be a different card
